name: Bathyal-Gibber
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past an exposed planetary core, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.
Nothing about the radiation hotspot appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
